description: Compose an object screen or workflow into a UiSchema. Use it when choosing layout and components; use pipeline_run instead for the complete generation flow or code_generate when you already have a schema. Returns schema, a 30-minute process-local schemaRef and durable compositionId/version lineage. Prefer explicit object and context over keyword-based intent. preferences controls region/field order and sample seed; compositionId appends a version, while options.transient records none. Save schemas with schema_store to reuse across sessions. Selected nodes snapshot component mappings; composition does not generate or run an app. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#design_compose; full schema: oods://schemas/design_compose.input.json.

compositionId.description: Record this composition as the next version of an existing composition (operation "recompose") instead of creating a new one.

context.description: View context for object-aware composition. See full schema for details.

intent.description: A short intent sentence (e.g., 'dashboard with metrics and sidebar', 'user registration form'), matched against fixed keyword and phrase tables, not understood; a sentence with no layout keyword becomes a low-confidence… See full schema for details.

layout.description: Layout template to use. 'landing' is a content/marketing page (hero + sections + CTA), not bound to a data object. 'auto' infers the best template from intent keywords.

object.description: Object name from the OODS registry (e.g., 'Subscription', 'User'). When provided, composition uses trait-driven component placement via view_extensions.

operation.description: With compositionId: the lineage operation recorded on the new version; default recompose. See full schema for details.

topN.description: Number of component candidates to return per slot.

transient.description: Do not record a composition version; the result then carries no compositionId. For scratch compositions only.

validate.description: Auto-validate the generated schema via the `repl` tool's `validate` action.

parentVersion.description: With compositionId: the version the new one derives from; default the latest.

brand.description: Brand scope for data-bound charts; defaults to A.

fieldGroups.description: Number of field groups for form layout.

fieldOrder.description: Region id → field names in the desired order among sibling field nodes of that region (a… See full schema for details.

metricColumns.description: Number of metric columns for dashboard layout.

regionOrder.description: The screen's regions (its direct children) by id in the desired order; regions not listed… See full schema for details.

seed.description: Sample-data seed. See full schema for details.

tabCount.description: Number of tabs for detail layout.

tabLabels.description: Custom tab labels for detail layout.

presentation.description: Named Stage1 inspection presentation: omit the accessibility score and prominently show measurement limits. Source records remain unchanged.
